The Euro-Sportring app is for all participants of Euro-Sportring's tournaments. The app is for players, trainers, coaches and managers, but also for parents and other supporters, who want to stay up to date with the scores of their team at the tournament. 

The app contains information, fixtures and results of all Euro-Sportring's tournaments and includes:

-       A dedicated section for each tournament
-       Schedule of matches
-       Results of matches
-       Time and location of matches
-       The option to follow your own team and other teams
-       See all the rounds of the tournament

The app is available to everyone and you only need to register an account within the app to access the content.
